# Workspace Sync

Google Workspace directory authority and guarded identity reconciliation.

Google Workspace supplies directory authority for guarded reconciliation with
Slack, GitHub, Linear, PagerDuty, Sentry and Trycomp. Provider clients, planners,
leases, write budgets and readbacks compose into host-owned workflows.

Configure one tenant per process or Worker isolate. Policy is cloned and frozen;
a different tenant requires a separate process or isolate. Credentials belong
in the host's secret store and must never appear in policy or logs. Isolate
persistence and provider credentials per tenant as well.

Trusted host code owns authentication, scheduling, migrations, persistence,
signed-plan approval and audit retention. Untrusted callers must not supply
policy, credentials or provider ports, or invoke provider writes directly.
Directory access defaults to the read-only scope. Write access requires an
explicit scope, narrow provider grants and the operation's authority guards.

Preserve fresh authority, reviewed plan hashes, provenance, write budgets,
leases and provider readbacks when composing an executor. D1 adapters expect
host-owned tables; the package does not migrate production databases.

## Install

Node.js >=24.0.0 is required. Install the qualified release archive:

```sh
pnpm add https://github.com/sarj-ai/workspace-sync/releases/download/v0.2.0/sarj-ai-workspace-sync-0.2.0.tgz
```

## Read-only example

Supply the two credential environment variables used below and pass your policy
file as the first command-line argument. Keep tenant configuration outside this
checkout. [The synthetic policy](https://engineering.sarj.ai/projects/workspace-sync/policy.example.json) shows the shape.

```ts
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";

import {
  configureWorkspaceSyncPolicy,
  getWorkspaceSyncPolicy,
} from "@sarj-ai/workspace-sync";
import { GoogleDirectoryClient } from "@sarj-ai/workspace-sync/org-sync/google-directory-client";

const policyPath = process.argv[2];
if (!policyPath)
  throw new Error("Usage: node audit-directory.ts /path/to/host-policy.json");
const input: unknown = JSON.parse(await readFile(policyPath, "utf8"));
configureWorkspaceSyncPolicy(input);
const policy = getWorkspaceSyncPolicy();

function requiredEnvironment(name: string): string {
  const value = process.env[name];
  if (!value?.trim()) throw new Error(`Missing environment variable: ${name}`);
  return value;
}

const directory = new GoogleDirectoryClient({
  adminSubject: policy.org.googleAdminSubject,
  privateKey: requiredEnvironment("GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY"),
  serviceAccountEmail: requiredEnvironment("GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL"),
  userProject: policy.org.googleUserProject,
});
const users = await directory.listAllUsers(
  crypto.randomUUID(),
  Date.now() + 60_000,
);
process.stdout.write(`Read ${String(users.length)} Directory users.\n`);
```
